transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the sustainment skills validation schedule finalized today. We have four modules to schedule across four training blocks: vehicle recovery procedures, load-planning procedures, radio-setup procedures, and heat-injury response. Before I can publish the final schedule, each module needs a written coordination control logged in the ledger under commitment type "coordination_control" with the affected module identified in the target field. Let's hear from each of you on your training requirements so we can lock this in.

transcript.text: I received a visit notice this morning from a higher-headquarters evaluator who will observe the load-planning procedures module at exactly 1500 on validation day.
